plainLanguage: Brownsville is in Cameron County, a Texas windstorm area, so a TDI windstorm certificate (WPI-8) is needed for TWIA insurance. Build with a continuous metal-strap load path, stronger roof-deck nailing, and impact-rated or shuttered windows and doors (design winds about 140-150 mph). Much of the city is low and flat, so flood elevation often drives the slab height. Zoning, code edition and fee values here are placeholders that must be verified.
